Origin and meaning

The name Abigail has Hebrew roots and means “my father's joy”.

About the name Abigail

In the Bible, Abigail was a wise and beautiful wife of King David.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Abigail suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
